note: Series grouping exceptions (docs/design/series.md §3.1; engine/series.py). subsidiary: AniList id -> parent id, listed as its own company. merge: groups of AniList ids that are one series although AniList does not link them. cut: pairs whose SEQUEL/PREQUEL relation is not followed. names: a series' name by any of its works (default: its first TV/ONA work's Chinese title). _why: the reason for each entry. Kept by hand each season, like sim/matches.json.

_why.167404: ONE PIECE「MONSTERS」(2024): an adaptation of Oda's one-shot, not the series; AniList links it as a sequel
_why.206814: ドラゴンボール超 ビルス (2026): an enhanced re-edit of ドラゴンボール超 by the same Toei team. Its line is the Super story: 神と神 and 復活の「F」 (AniList: ALTERNATIVE to 超, the arcs 超 retells), 超, ブロリー, スーパーヒーロー (AniList links it only through the unaired 銀河パトロール) and what follows; not Dragon Ball, Z, GT, 改 and DAIMA (cut). AniList relates ビルス to 超 as PARENT (its source), not as a sequel
_why.8687: ドラえもん (2005): the 1979 series (and the 1973 one before it) are other productions of decades before, not its prequels
_why.178869: name: the first season's Chinese title carries its own subtitle (魔兽之王与婴儿与尸之勇者); the series is Clevatess
